To: #announcements

Subject: nov 21 charity stream — $600 for linden pantry

@everyone charity stream is SATURDAY NOV 21, 10am–10pm eastern, for Linden Community Pantry. putting this up early so half the server doesn't find out the day of again lol. last year we raised $212 with basically no notice. this year the goal is $600.

rook is matching the first $100 people donate, so those first donations count double. even $3 helps — the pantry says every $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food through their wholesale partner. they're serving around 340 families a week rn, and their shelves are really low heading into Thanksgiving.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
it goes straight to the pantry, not through me, with nothing taken off. they buy the food.

here's what you're making me do:
$100 — full round with my controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and i dye it ON STREAM
$400 — an hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — grocery pickup vlog, arranged by the pantry

yes it's a charity stream. yes i'm asking for donations. but it's not begging if u get hair dye content out of it lol. mostly i just want us to hang out, play games and get some food on those shelves.

first half is community lobbies — anyone can join, i'll drop codes. second half, chat votes on the game every 2 hours. no repeat maps, larry, i heard you.

no card / can't donate? you're still invited. come play, hang in chat, or share the stream with someone who might be into it. if you've got canned or boxed food to drop off, the pantry takes it in the blue bin by their side door on Saturdays, 9am–1pm.

seriously, no guilt if money's tight. showing up counts too. put nov 21 in your calendar now so i'm not explaining the entire event ten minutes before we start. see u there
